basic_info.description: Lovely remodeled home with beautiful detail includes a comfortable living space of large living room with wood burning fireplace,  remodeled eat-in kitchen with stainless appliances (gas range),  formal dining room, remodeled split bath with tub and tiled stall shower. Generous bedrooms with garden outlooks.  Large, flat rear landscaped level backyard/garden with generous, inviting patio and beautiful greenery, great for outdoor gatherings.  120 foot deep lot per tax records. The large garage with plenty of storage space adds the finishing touches to the special home. Room for Expansion!   New water heater installed 2024, new dual stage forced air gas furnace, new insulated ducting.  Close to shopping, restaurants, cafes, playgrounds, parks, public transportation HWY 280 and more!  2 car garage parking plus space in driveway for 3rd car.
